name: taskdag
description: Repo-native ADR + Task DAG data plane: structured task/decision docs, vendored lifecycle CLI, generated DAG board

interface.shortDescription: Repo-native ADR + Task DAG data plane.
interface.longDescription: Structured task and architecture-decision docs governed by a vendored zero-dependency CLI (validate/query/transition/board), with a generated single-file DAG board and lane-based write-surface isolation. Model selection and dispatch are left to a separate dispatch capability.
defaultPrompt: Use $taskdag to adopt the task DAG system in this repository.
Use $taskdag to pick the next runnable task and record its outcome.
